fusions.name: Bend the Knee
fusions.desc: Brings your sceptre down, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning them for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Pronounced Sentence
fusions.desc: Levels your sceptre and looses a bolt that deals 26 damage with a 50% chance to leave the target [Suppressed] for 5 seconds. When it hits, your party deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Raised Standard
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Weight of Office
fusions.desc: Every ability you use builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (35% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
